I rewatched Part II out of order to see what visually caught my eye and the framing of some shots is so interesting to me. I couldn’t figure out how to get them within the text body so I apologize for that. I’ve bolded what image to look at where it was originally meant to be in the text. 
 Ruskin tells Karim about astronauts in Part II episode 7, “Our ancestors, the hunters and the gatherers, they looked up at the moon and they saw a goddess. Something to be worshipped from afar. We looked up at the moon and wanted to land there. The entire space race was all about who could put a man on the moon first. We were obsessed.
